features.title: Object storage on Azure Blob, deployable through Azure DevOps
features.description: Move object storage from MinIO to Azure Blob for production on Azure. ObjectStore stays the only seam; SDK calls move behind a StorageBackend with MinIO (local default) and Azure implementations. User decisions 2026-11-09: no data migration, Azure starts empty, so no copy, checksum check, re-tagging or write freeze.

tasks.title: StorageBackend protocol and MinioBackend
tasks.detail: apps/python/intergrations/storage_backends.py. Behaviour and error messages unchanged on MinIO.

tasks.title: AzureBlobBackend
tasks.detail: DefaultAzureCredential, user delegation SAS scoped to one blob, blob index tags, copy polling. Azurite connection string for tests only.

tasks.title: Trainer sends x-ms-blob-type, image 1.0.28
tasks.detail: images/trainer/app/storage.py. One image for both stores. Built locally as scgc/soft-sensor-trainer:1.0.28; 125 trainer tests pass inside it. Not pushed.

tasks.title: Bicep
tasks.detail: infra/: storage, lifecycle rule for lifecycle=tmp, identity with Storage Blob Data Owner, ACR. Flat namespace, Shared Key off. Compiles with az bicep build. Not yet deployed.

tasks.title: Azure DevOps pipeline
tasks.detail: azure-pipelines.yml: CI, Images (trainer, serving), Infra. Dev only. No app deploy stage until AZURE-HOST-001 is decided. YAML parses. First real run needs an Azure DevOps org.

tasks.title: Train, predict, export on Azure dev
tasks.detail: Local stack with STORAGE_BACKEND=azure against a real storage account. Needs the user's subscription, az login, Bicep deploy and Redis from CONTAINER-QUEUE-001.

acceptance_criteria: MinIO behaviour and error messages are unchanged with STORAGE_BACKEND=minio
The contract test passes against MinIO and Azurite
Containers receive only SAS URLs scoped to one blob; no account key exists in the app
Train, predict and export work against a real Azure storage account
known_gaps: Backend and client tests are continueOnError in the pipeline: 9 backend suites and 20 client cases were already red.
Pipeline has not run in Azure DevOps and Bicep has not been deployed.
Azurite signs with an account key, so a real user delegation SAS is only proven by T06.
The 7-day lifecycle deletion will not be observed during T06; only the rule and tags are.
CI has no MinIO, so its live storage tests run against Azurite only.
features.blocked_by: T06 needs the user: an Azure subscription, az login, deploying infra/env/dev.bicepparam, Redis configured (CONTAINER-QUEUE-001-T02), and TRAINING_IMAGE set to 1.0.28.

features.title: Decide how containers run on Azure
features.description: Recorded by user request 2026-11-09 and deferred. Storage work does not depend on it, but deploying the app does.
features.blocked_by: The backend spawns train, score, batch and inference containers through /var/run/docker.sock (trainning-container.authorized.service.ts). TRAINING network monorepo_network is hard-coded there, and ContainerDispatchService counts capacity on one Docker host.
investigated: Azure Container Apps and Container Apps Jobs do not allow privileged containers or expose a host container socket.
Azure Container Instances gives no access to the container runtime.
AKS nodes use containerd, so there is no Docker socket; this path needs spawn, listRunning, adopt, kill and the budget rewritten for Kubernetes Jobs.
A VM or VM Scale Set with Docker works with the current code, at the cost of operating the VM and a root-equivalent socket.
information_required: Whether the organisation allows VMs or mandates AKS.
Expected concurrent trainings, to size the host.
Whether users reach Azure through VPN or a VNet.
features.decision_needed: VM with Docker or AKS with Kubernetes Jobs. Recommendation: VM first, because it needs the least change.

tasks.title: Redis on Azure
tasks.detail: Self-hosted on the VM or a managed Redis. BullMQ needs maxmemory-policy noeviction.

tasks.title: Browser access to private storage
tasks.detail: Dataset Export opens a SAS URL directly from the browser (use-dataset-export.ts). If public network access is off and users are outside the VNet, the download fails and must be streamed through the backend.

acceptance_criteria: A training container runs on the chosen Azure host and reaches both the backend and Blob Storage
